code='''def transform(grid):\n    n = len(grid)\n    idx = [n-1-i if i < n else 0 for i in range(3*n)]\n    # Reflection across the boundaries of the central copy.\n    idx = [n-1-i if i < n else (i-n if i < 2*n else 3*n-1-i) for i in range(3*n)]\n    return [[grid[idx[r]][idx[c]] for c in range(3*n)] for r in range(3*n)]\n'''
